20 Minute Yoga Nidra for Deep Rest
Unwind completely with this 20 minute yoga nidra practice designed to guide your body and nervous system into deep rest. Yoga nidra is a form of guided meditation that moves you into the space between waking and sleep, where the body can release tension and the mind can finally slow down.
This practice is ideal for:
Stress relief
Better sleep
Resetting an overstimulated nervous system
